exposure: Uterine segment thickness measured via transabdominal ultrasound
cohort: 100 women with previous caesarean section attending the antenatal outpatient department at Andhra Medical College between 37-40 weeks of gestation from August 2022 to January 2023
finding: A lower uterine segment thickness of >3.5mm was associated with a lower likelihood of uterine dehiscence during labor in women with a previous caesarean section.
